title: My Sister and a Winter Party
text:
Today is the twelfth of March. My sister's name is Lucy. She is a teacher, and she works in a school. Her birthday is in October.

Our family has a big party in December. It is on the twenty-fourth. We cook dinner and sing songs together. I like winter because it is cold and snowy.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the party?
options: The writer is happy about it
The writer is angry about it
The writer is bored by it
The writer is afraid of it

questions.text: Where is the family probably during the party?

vocabulary.definition: a person whose job is to teach people in a school
the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring
an event where people meet to eat, drink, and have fun
the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: Hoje é dia doze de março. O nome da minha irmã é Lucy. Ela é professora e trabalha em uma escola. O aniversário dela é em outubro.
A nossa família tem uma festa grande em dezembro. É no dia vinte e quatro. Nós cozinhamos o jantar e cantamos músicas juntos. Eu gosto do inverno porque é frio e neva.
